[LADP.4.2.1] Required slot on every adapter schema:

| Slot | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `ts` | `Time` | The UTC instant at which the source observed the fact, supplied by the adapter ([LFAC.9.2]): source time, compared with `now()` by rules that need it. Load-bearing for series and `then` ordering; `t.dwell` and `within <dur>` do not read it ([LTIM.2.8.6]). |
